# Entire-platform completion work ledger

Generated from the complete source register and page business-section analyses. **100% is the required target, not a measured result.** Planning inventory validation is separate from implemented/tested/deployed readiness. No page, alias, unmapped registration or shared subsystem is silently dropped.

## Execution order

1. Fix demonstrated reachable defects and preserve failure receipts; partition independent owned changes by source file.
2. Execute every named page section, control and API contract; implement missing behavior and add successful/adverse assertions with exact persistence/authorization evidence.
3. Close shared subsystem and non-JS/native/configuration lanes in parallel where dependencies allow. Keep device/provider/deployment prerequisites explicit.
4. Freeze all implementation/config/test inputs; run the full master and valid source-mapped coverage for all four 100% metrics, plus separate Python/Go/Rust/native proof.
5. Reconcile every remaining counter and feature check, actual Replit image/deployment, migration/backup/recovery, provider delivery and measured topology/capacity. Commit and normally push current evidence; main promotion requires the actual release gates.
